subject: MAP: Target close & procurement signature alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Green <samantha.green@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & target close alignment

Hi Samantha

Great to connect on the call today. Thanks for walking through FinTechCo's Ask and timelines. Per our discussion I attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that captures milestones, owners, and dependencies. Key items to confirm:

- Target close date: 2027-05-20 (goal: signed contract + provisioning complete)
- Procurement / contract signature deadline: 2027-05-12 (we requested this to ensure legal & procurement routing completes ahead of the provisioning window)
- Key milestones:
  - SOC2 evidence review (FinTechCo to confirm): by 2027-04-12
  - Procurement review & redlines (FinTechCo): by 2027-04-26
  - Final contract review (Redwood legal): by 2027-05-05
  - Signature (both parties): by 2027-05-12
  - Provisioning & go-live prep (Redwood & FinTechCo): 2027-05-13 to 2027-05-19
  - Official close / go-live: 2027-05-20

Responsibilities:
- FinTechCo: procurement & legal approvals, SOC2 confirmation, procurement contact (Daniel) to coordinate.
- Redwood: provide SOC2 artifact, answer security questionnaire, deliver final SOW and redline responses, provision Dedicated capacity.

Dependencies / Risks:
- SOC2 evidence availability (if procurement needs deeper artifacts it may push review time).
- Contract redlines that require extended legal review.

Next steps:
1) Samantha / Daniel please review the attached MAP and confirm if the procurement signature deadline of 2027-05-12 is achievable or needs to be moved earlier.
2) If procurement needs an earlier signature, let us know proposed date and we’ll adjust the timeline accordingly.
3) Camila and I will pull SOC2 artifact links and share with your procurement & security reviewers by end of this week.

Attachment: [Attachment: FinTechCo_MAP_Draft_20270330.docx (DOCX)]

Thanks happy to hop on a 20-min follow-up if helpful.
—
Marissa Cole

Marissa

Thanks for the recap and the MAP draft. This looks good and mirrors the internal timeline we discussed. A couple items from procurement's side: 

- Procurement asks whether we can move the signature deadline up to 2027-05-10. Our fiscal expectations for May require the contract signed in the system before 2027-05-12 to meet internal approval cycles.
- Daniel (cc'd) will be the primary procurement contact and will coordinate the redlines with our legal team.

If Redwood can accept a signature deadline of 2027-05-10, that gives us enough buffer. Otherwise we'll need to escalate internally which could push the go-live.

We can do a 30-minute call Thursday to align if that helps.

Best,
